governingRule: LLP 0044 §3 Lane C: retirement requires a closed-world source join plus loaded-target absence or immutable-closure evidence mapped exactly to every credited row.

method.authorableTest: A physical callable is not an invocation path to a credited cell unless its loaded typed decisions can name that cell’s edge. An outer façade whose effects are attributed only at exact inner gates is an ill-typed duplicate cell, not an authorable obligation.
closedWorldJoin: Enumerate every baseline row credited to each of the 14 edge IDs and assert publicSurfaceProbe:null plus the Lane C residual.
Join each observed key through the complete implementation manifest, root-global disposition manifest, generated surface inventory, and semantic coverage registry.
Inspect every source-defined installation, capture, deletion, alias, delegate, and Host terminal that can lie below the observed key.
Search all non-generated runtime/tool source for every retired seed edge ID; require zero emitters.
Execute the armed loaded-target regression and compare all typed decision edge IDs.
Require the strict route-evidence diff and terminal-evidence diff to exit zero.

summary.verdict: A2 is unblocked by Lane C: all 14 cells were provably ill-typed duplicate façade/private-bridge effect cells.

C1-LANE-C-RULE.claim: Lane C retirement requires a closed-world source join plus loaded-target absence or immutable-closure evidence mapped to every credited row.

C2-BASELINE-CATALOG.claim: All 138 credited rows for the 14 cells have publicSurfaceProbe:null and residualReasons including native-public-source-invocation-unavailable.

C3-COMPLETE-INVENTORY.claim: The generated implementation, root-global, surface, and semantic-edge inventories are the closed source authorities joined by the recipe generator.

C4-RESOLVER-CAPTURE.claim: Bootstrap captures the resolver functions into private lexical bindings, deletes all four raw globals in armed posture, and public require.resolve delegates through the captured metadata resolver.

C5-RESOLVER-INSTALL.claim: Canonical/native resolver spellings share one installed function; authenticated session resolvers call the host resolver APIs; all four raw globals are required absent after lockdown.

C6-RESOLVER-GATES.claim: Resolver metadata authorization names surface.loader.require.resolve.12c9l9i and authenticated source reads name surface.native.op.exactreadfile.1cmzco7.

C7-MODULE-FACADES.claim: require/import/importModule are lexical façades over checkImportGate, load/importImpl, and captured resolvers; import and importModule share the same function object.

C8-WHICH.claim: Exact.which delegates to __exactWhich; the armed Host maps operation 32 to surface.native.op.exactwhich.0it66ce.

C9-WRITE.claim: Exact/Bun write share exactWrite, which calls __exactWriteFile; the armed Host maps that operation to surface.native.op.exactwritefile.1h0gy8u.

C10-HANDLE-CLOSURE.claim: Returned methods call the one legacy numeric-bearer reader, while secure armed Hosts reject any such bearer at use time; a seeded-valid-bearer regression proves the closure.

observations.path: loaded require.resolve closure to captured resolver host

C12-PRIOR-RESOLVER-SPIKE.claim: Independent loaded-target resolver observations credited only loader.require.resolve and exactreadfile, never an upper resolver façade.

C13-SEED-EDGE-ABSENCE.command: rg -n '<14 exact retired edge IDs>' src packages scripts --glob '!**/*generated*' --glob '!packages/ibex-devtools/src/scripts/capsec-coverage-model.test.mjs'
C13-SEED-EDGE-ABSENCE.claim: No non-generated runtime, host, loader, or tool source can emit any retired seed edge ID; occurrences are confined to generated registry consumers and audit artifacts.

C14-DIFF-GATES.claim: The exact-string reclassification removed 138 old effect recipes and added 14 non-capability recipes without changing any terminal evidence.
